disclosures.information: The boot contains Grumble, a pocket storm; he lost his family while following toast down a chimney.
Family will cross hills at sunset; Grumble needs a proper breeze to rise high.
Drinking water enlarges and weighs down pocket storms; a rumble releases water as rain.
Grumble is embarrassed by his squeaky thunder.
The family answers in several different sounds and receives Grumble. Withhold the full chorus before page 26.
Grumble can send a nighttime greeting; a tiny rainbow is found in the right boot the following morning. Do not reveal rainbow in earlier ornaments.
